observation-primitive-rs-main/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "observation-primitive"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "The canonical substrate atom: observation as fundamental primitive"
license = "MIT"
homepage = "https://github.com/SuperInstance/observation-primitive-rs"
repository = "https://github.com/SuperInstance/observation-primitive-rs"
authors = ["SuperInstance"]
keywords = ["observation", "substrate", "jev-quilt", "canon", "fnv1a"]
categories = ["data-structures", "no-std"]
readme = "README.md"

[lib]
name = "observation_primitive"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
